about: Measured minutes per full-mutation lane on int21h-ws, from board/ci main #325 (EXTENDED=true MUTATION_FULL=true, 24 Nov 2026: three units side by side beside the Stability unit, as every full run). A unit's predicted minutes are the sum of its lanes' minutes (plus Stryker for the unit holding lane base) plus unit_overhead_minutes. Read by TestFullMutationUnitsAreBalancedFromTheLaneTable. Raw inputs: artifacts 012/full-325 of the run that wrote it.
lane_minutes_about: A gremlins lane is the sum over its packages (or parts) of ci/mutation.sh's covered run ('covered run of ./<pkg> took Ns' in the console; a second part of one package reuses the first part's run) plus gremlins' elapsed_time in that package's archived report (ci-results/mutation/internal-<pkg>.json). Stryker is 'ci/mutation.sh: stryker over web/src/lib' to its report line (MutationTestExecutor: Done in 33 minutes and 59 seconds).
scaling_about: #325 ran after task 013 (internal/server tests faster), task 021 (mutants run the SQLite leg only) and task 024 (internal/cli tests faster) had landed, so their speed-ups are already in these minutes and no factor is applied. Jenkins no longer holds the consoles of main 265, 271 and 272 (their unit totals only survive in the PRD: 90.6/95.6/102.5, 107.4/100.3/105.6, three units cut at 110.5), so their per-lane split cannot be read.
unit_overhead_about: A unit's run minutes in #325's timing.md less its lanes' minutes: server-core+logic 65.8 - 63.1 = 2.7, ops+cli 74.8 - 73.4 = 1.4, streams+base+Stryker 59.4 - 57.8 = 1.6 (container start, gremlins' work copies, the gate of the unit); the largest is charged to every unit.

server-core.basis: internal/server#core: covered run 16 s + gremlins 1043.8 s

server-ops.basis: internal/server#ops: covered run 31 s + gremlins 1191.4 s

server-streams.basis: internal/server#streams: covered run 18 s + gremlins 571.0 s

cli-core.basis: internal/cli#core: covered run 27 s + gremlins 1715.2 s

base.basis: internal/domain 1 s + 90.7 s, internal/store 63 s + 670.6 s
